name: @overleaf-ext/tests-e2e
description: Forgejo-style Playwright e2e suite for the ext 6.3.0 Overleaf fork. Runs ONLY against the disposable test stack (docker-compose.test.yml) — never the production box.

scripts.stack:logs: docker compose -f docker-compose.test.yml --project-name ol-e2e logs --tail 50 overleaf
scripts.test: npm run stack:up && npx playwright test
